content.rendered:
X Ambassadors make absolutely no secret about their appreciation for Bruce’s music–they cite him as an influence on their music pretty frequently in interviews. Heck in 2016, they even said they’d have cut their show short in order to catch his encore when they learned he’d been playing just across the street from them in Brooklyn.

So it was probably inevitable that the guys would eventually cover one of Bruce’s songs.

That moment came last year, in March of 2018–and when they chose a song, they chose wisely, eschewing the hits and zeroing in on one of Bruce’s deepest and most atmospheric cuts.

Here’s the X Ambassadors’ wonderful take on Bruce’s “Stolen Car.’

© May 15, 2019

excerpt.rendered: From March 2018, the X Ambassadors prove their fandom by delivering a fantastic, moody cover of Bruce’s “Stolen Car.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Trace Jory: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Trace Jory was introduced to "Stolen Car" through X Ambassador's creative cover, but he drew on Bruce's original arrangement for his own rendition.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Lizanne Knott: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Lizanne Knott celebrated Bruce's 60th birthday by recording a wistful cover of deep cut "Stolen Car."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Tom Cunliffe: Born to Run
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Auckland-based Tom Sutcliffe turns in a tender reading of Bruce’s signature song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Sting: The Rising
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Backed by a full choir, in the presence of the President and First Lady, Sting paid tribute to his good friend at the 2009 Kennedy Center Honors.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Doc Walker: Girls in Their Summer Clothes
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Canadian band Doc Walker finds a tender country song lurking inside Bruce's underappreciated pop single, "Girls in Their Summer Clothes."

jetpack-related-posts.title: No Money Down
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: You've heard snippets in River-era bootlegs, but if you haven't heard the one and only recording of Bruce's full cover of "No Money Down" from way back in 1974, you need to listen to this definitive version inside.
